summary.text: Harry B. Bronson is the incumbent Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 138 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and former Monroe County legislator, he was first elected to the Assembly in 2010 and chairs the Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bronson grew up on a rural family farm with 11 siblings, earned an undergraduate degree in Public Justice from SUNY Oswego, and graduated from the University at Buffalo law school.
As an attorney and former partner at Blitman and King, he focused on anti-discrimination employment law, labor issues, employee benefits and litigation.
He and his husband, John, co-owned Equal=Grounds, a coffee house in Rochester's South Wedge neighborhood, for 18 years.
Before his election to the Assembly, Bronson served in the Monroe County Legislature, where he held leadership positions including Minority Leader.
He was first elected to the Assembly in November 2010 and represents the 138th District, which includes parts of the City of Rochester and the towns of Henrietta, West Henrietta, Chili and Riga.
He chairs the Committee on Labor and is a member of the Education, Ethics and Guidance, Rules, and Ways and Means committees; he previously chaired the Economic Development committee.
